task.goal: Mount a wired PoE IP camera above my garage door
task.details: Brick wall, cable runs from a PoE switch inside

plan.title: Mount wired PoE camera above garage door
plan.summary: Mount PoE camera centered above garage door on brick, drill and plug bracket, route indoor PoE cable, aim and verify live view.
plan.sourceNote: AI-written plan · check your owner's manual

steps.title: Choose mounting spot
steps.instruction: Stand back and choose a spot centered above the garage door on brick, high enough to see driveway but reachable by ladder. Hold camera there without drilling and check phone app view if possible. Confirm cable can reach from inside.

cautions.text: Do not lean out from ladder to check view

stopIf: no solid brick or mortar joint to fix to
cable from inside cannot reach spot

steps.title: Power off and set ladder
steps.instruction: Switch off PoE switch inside. Set ladder stable on level ground in front of garage door. Put on safety glasses and dust mask. Lay out drill, level, pencil and mount.

cautions.text: Unplug or switch off PoE switch before handling cable ends
Set ladder on level firm ground and lock it

steps.title: Mark holes level
steps.instruction: Climb ladder, hold mounting bracket level above garage door, mark screw holes with pencil. Check marks against camera manual for spacing. Confirm no wires or pipes behind marks.

cautions.text: Wear eye protection and dust mask for brick dust
Drill bit is sharp and hot after drilling

stopIf: brick is cracked or crumbling at marks

steps.title: Drill masonry holes
steps.instruction: Drill pilot holes into brick or mortar joint with masonry bit as shown in camera manual. Drill straight and to plug depth only. Clear dust from holes.

cautions.text: Wear eye protection, brick dust can injure eyes
Avoid hidden cables, stop if drill hits resistance unlike brick

stopIf: brick cracks or hole is loose

steps.title: Fit wall plugs
steps.instruction: Push wall plugs from kit into drilled holes until flush with brick. Tap lightly if needed.

cautions.text: Tap gently to avoid splitting brick edges

stopIf: plugs spin loose or will not grip

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Plugs flush with brick face with no cracks

steps.title: Fix camera mount
steps.instruction: Fix camera base or bracket to wall with screws from kit using screwdriver. Check with level and tighten evenly. Confirm screw size and plug type in manual if unsure.

cautions.text: Keep one hand on ladder when fixing screws

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Bracket tight to wall with no wobble

steps.title: Connect PoE cable
steps.instruction: Route ethernet cable from inside to camera, leaving a small drip loop below camera. Plug into camera ethernet port and seal gland as per manual. Clip cable neatly along wall.

cautions.text: Keep PoE power off while plugging cable

stopIf: connector is damaged or will not click

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Cable clicked into camera with drip loop and no strain

steps.title: Aim and tighten camera
steps.instruction: Attach camera to mount, aim lens at driveway and garage door. Tighten adjustment screws by hand. Confirm torque and settings in owners manual.

cautions.text: Do not overreach while aiming camera

check.whatDoneLooksLike: Camera aimed at driveway and tightened

steps.title: Power on and verify
steps.instruction: Climb down, switch on PoE switch inside. Wait 2 minutes then check phone app for live view and adjust aim if needed. Confirm waterproofing and cable entry per product label.

cautions.text: Check cable is dry and seated before power on

stopIf: water can enter at cable hole
